content.tours.text-074: Frequently Asked Questions on Nha Trang Island Tours
content.tours.text-075: Can children or seniors join the 3-island speedboat tour?
content.tours.text-076: Absolutely! {{brand.name}} uses modern covered composite speedboats that glide smoothly across sheltered Nha Trang Bay. At Hon Tam, electric buggies take seniors and young children directly to the hot mud bath and restaurant.
content.tours.text-077: Can I go coral diving or snorkeling if I cannot swim?
content.tours.text-078: Yes! For scuba diving or Seawalker underwater walking, a certified 1-on-1 instructor guides you safely underwater. Life jackets, masks, and snorkels are also provided.
content.tours.text-079: What happens if it rains or the sea is rough?
content.tours.text-080: Your safety is {{brand.name}}'s #1 priority. If port authorities suspend boats due to weather, we notify you early and refund 100% of any deposit or help switch to a suitable city tour.

content.transfers.text-164: Frequently Asked Questions on Airport & Car Transfers
content.transfers.text-165: 1. How do I recognize my pickup driver at Cam Ranh Airport?
content.transfers.text-166: 30 minutes before landing, dispatch sends your driver details (name, phone, license plate) via Zalo/SMS. Exiting arrivals, your driver holds
content.transfers.text-167: a welcome board with your name clearly printed
content.transfers.text-168: right at the lobby. If crowded, call the driver or hotline {{contact.phone}} for immediate assistance.
content.transfers.text-169: 2. Will I be charged extra waiting fees if my flight is delayed?
content.transfers.text-171: {{brand.name}} operations tracks your flight radar in real time. Even if delayed 1-3 hours, your driver adjusts to the new landing time and waits for you.
content.transfers.text-172: 3. What taxes and fees are included in the listed transfer prices?
content.transfers.text-175: : covering fuel, driver service, Cam Ranh Airport entry fees, and highway tolls. No tipping or hidden fees apply (except unscheduled detours).
content.transfers.text-176: 4. Can we stop for photos along the way from Nha Trang to Da Lat or Phu Yen?
content.transfers.text-177: Yes! Because it is a Private Car charter, you control the pace. Along Khanh Le Pass (Da Lat) or Ca Pass - Vung Ro Bay (Phu Yen), the driver happily stops for 15-20 minute scenic photos or coffee breaks at no extra charge.
content.transfers.text-178: 5. What payment methods are accepted for transfer services?
content.transfers.text-180: Pay cash directly to the driver
content.transfers.text-181: after completing the trip, or transfer via VietQR / MoMo / VNPay to {{brand.name}}'s company account.
